purpose: Rules for how Claude Code plugin Python scripts report exit codes, stdout JSON errors, and stderr, so AI callers can branch on failures reliably.

sections.heading: `3` 以上に共通の意味を置かない理由

summary: Exit code 0/1/2 have shared meanings; 3 and above are defined per script
Completion judgment excludes result content such as zero findings
Scripts returning 3 or higher must declare a full exit code table in the module docstring
Wrappers passing through exit codes must declare the range or fold to 0/1/2
Callers branch on a value only if the producer docstring declares it
Stdout carries result JSON on 0 and error JSON with an errors array otherwise
Exit code 2 from argparse leaves stdout empty by design
Stderr may hold diagnostics but errors must also be in stdout JSON
Existing scripts are not violations; applies to newly placed scripts
Harness-defined I/O contracts such as hooks are exempt
tasks: Writing a new Python script for a plugin
Writing the module docstring exit code table
Writing SKILL.md steps that react to script exit codes
Refactoring an existing script toward the rules
